null_encoding: Empty CSV cell; JSON/API numeric null is None/null; never substitute zero
row_granularity: One whole BASS or BASS-II test; conditions may vary within a test
cross_validation_group: validation_group in stage files; whole-test split_group retained for compatibility
training_gate: Use the selected FLEX scope and feature list in model/model_spec.json; solid-stage candidates remain exploratory evidence, not the selected predictor

oxygen_final_pct.use: provenance or review; not a feature

airflow_cm_s.unit: cm/s; single Air display reading only

co2_final_pct.use: provenance or review; not a feature

co_initial_ppm_raw.use: provenance or review; not a feature

co_final_ppm_raw.use: provenance or review; not a feature

burned_binary.use: Any visible flame reported anywhere in test; not the sustained-flame stage target

label_status.use: provenance or review; not a feature

notes.use: provenance or review; not a feature

quality_flags.use: provenance or review; not a feature

source_file.use: provenance or review; not a feature

source_row.use: provenance or review; not a feature

supplement_file.use: provenance or review; not a feature

supplement_locator.use: provenance or review; not a feature

source_url.use: provenance or review; not a feature

dataset_roles.solid_combustion_model.csv: Reviewed whole-test observations; not independent condition labels
dataset_roles.flex_backup.csv: liquid droplet fallback only; never pool with solids
dataset_roles.ground_thresholds.csv: Earth comparison; 70 configuration-specific threshold pairs, not burn outcomes
dataset_roles.source_tables/: NASA table values; heterogeneous headers, units and note rows
dataset_roles.solid_stage_observations.csv: Evidence-linked events; includes unknown conditions and excluded endpoints
dataset_roles.solid_stage_training.csv: Conservative sustained-flame stage candidates with measured airspeed; initial oxygen is a proxy, protocol is required
dataset_roles.airflow_readings.csv: Instrument reading order only; no inferred outcome or reconstructed timestamp
dataset_roles.flex_training.csv: Separate terminal-extinction classifier candidates; disruptions censored

solid_stage_training.csv.positive: source-reported sustained/established flame at the selected event
solid_stage_training.csv.negative: source-reported failure to sustain or extinction at the selected event
solid_stage_training.csv.oxygen_caveat: oxygen_initial_pct is not actual stage oxygen; oxygen_at_stage_pct remains unknown
solid_stage_training.csv.protocol: ignition_trial versus ongoing_burn_trial; both categories contain both labels
